title: Daily Life Score Composite
dataSources: Daily life scores (`lifescore:daily`), personal SLO status (`personalslo:status`), cross-signal correlations (`correlation:pair`), plus every other `index=personal` sourcetype as input.
app: The meta layer — correlating every `index=personal` feed (sleep, activity, mood, weather, spend, productivity, home telemetry) into daily life scores, personal SLOs, and cross-signal anomaly detection, all computed in Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifescore:daily
| timechart span=1d avg(score) as life_score
| eventstats avg(life_score) as base
| eval good_day=if(life_score>base,1,0)
description: Blends sleep, activity, mood, and productivity into a single daily life score you can watch trend.
value: One honest composite is easier to act on than a dozen scattered metrics, turning self-tracking into a clear signal.
implementation: Compute a weighted daily score from your feeds into `index=personal`; trend it over time.
visualization: Line chart of the daily life score with a personal baseline.
grandmaExplanation: It blends your sleep, activity, mood, and focus into one daily score, a simple read on how life is going.
